Project identity:
Ignition is a cross-domain structural inference and theory-generation framework.
Current version: 2026-07-09 meta-protocol generation layer.
Ψ₀ is the meta-judgment and convergence framework (C × M × I_iso × L_meta × G_δ × P_meta).
12 meta-protocols are the expanded P_meta theory-generation layer (V1–V4 value, S1–S4 structure, E1–E4 evolution).
64 protocol combinations (V×S×E) are a theoretical generation space, not empirical exhaustion.
Unified Function Table and Unified Case Table are reviewed asset stores (617 functions, 804 cases as of 2026-07-09).
Book validation cases (22) are candidate materials unless assigned formal C IDs.
The Life Community Value Charter is the project’s normative value boundary. It does not replace evidence, validation, semantic review, or governance approval.
See: docs/governance/life-community-value-charter.md

Key paths:
- README.md : human + project entry
- SUMMARY.md : reading navigation
- docs/PROJECT-ARCHITECTURE.md : architecture
- docs/USAGE.md : human usage
- docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md : agent execution rules
- docs/GET-BRAIN-WORKFLOW.md : Get-Brain (得到大脑) collaboration
- docs/VERSIONING.md : versioning policy
- docs/meta-protocols/ : 12 protocols + 64 matrix + 22 book candidates
- data/meta-protocols/ : machine-readable JSON (validate with tools/validate_meta_protocols.py)
- 统一函数总表/ and 统一案例总表/ : formal reviewed tables (DO NOT modify unless explicit task)

Red lines for agents:
- Do NOT modify Ψ₀ math definition or replace Ψ₀.
- Do NOT modify 统一函数总表/ or 统一案例总表/ (INDEX or bodies).
- Do NOT assign C IDs to the 22 book candidates, and do NOT count 12 meta-protocols as functions.
- Never claim Ignition has externally proven a scientific or mathematical theorem.
- Never claim 64 combinations exhaust all reality; distinguish real_case vs inferred_shape.
- Always run tools/validate_meta_protocols.py and tools/validate_data.py before commit.
